label: MEASURED

inputs.peak_source: P-H3 sustained, MEASURED at the author's overclock (trainer master 11.12)
inputs.design: activations int8 per row per 32 (scale and sum); Q4_K quants unpacked to int8 in registers; mma.sync m16n8k32 s8; per-sub-block fp32 epilogue d*sc*acc - dmin*m*sum
inputs.v4: revision 3: exact magic-number int32->fp32 instead of I2F, min term from the precomputed scale*sum, 4-bit words loaded once per K step for both sub-blocks, ldmatrix.x4 for A
inputs.v7: revision 7: activations int8 with one scale per 256 (Q8_K-style layout, written from scratch); sum_j sc_j * dot_j in int32 (one IMAD per accumulator per sub-block), d * sa applied once per super-block; min term one FFMA per accumulator per sub-block from (sa * sum) x (dmin * m)
inputs.v8: revision 8: v7's arithmetic with 3 or 4 cp.async stages in dynamic shared memory, one barrier per K step, and a 16-byte weight record (d, eight 6-bit scales) per weight row and super-block prepared once per weight
inputs.v9: revision 9: v8's arithmetic with 16 warps per 128x128 tile (512 threads, warp tile 32x32, registers capped at 128), weight scales by column so each pair comes in one load; 2 or 3 stages
inputs.v10: revision 10: v8's integer main term (1 mma + 4 IMAD per mma); the min term once per super-block as one bf16 m16n8k16 product of exact digits (activation sums as 64 hi + lo, weight mins as 64 m and m), then acc -= sa256 * dmin * that; 2 or 3 stages
inputs.v11: revision 11: v10's arithmetic with 16 warps per 128x128 tile (512 threads, warp tile 32x32, registers capped at 128), load work spread over all warps; 2 or 3 stages
inputs.conversions: revision 11: activation conversion timed with a cold L2 (64 MiB overwritten before each call); RMSNorm to bf16 against RMSNorm fused with the int8 quantization; ratios include norm, weight dequant (bf16 path) and the fastest correct int8 kernel
inputs.q6k: not in this revision (P-K2b; its sub-blocks of 16 need m16n8k16 s8)
